Ordering x≥y≥z gives ≥x²+y²+z²+xy. The universal ℓ_(8/5)² inequality follows by differentiating H_t(s), reducing to (1+2t^(8/5))^(5/4)≤1+t+2t², and the convex-chord bound with sharp lower ratio min_t(t+2t²)/t^(8/5)=(5/2)(4/3)^(3/5). Independently confirmed exact integer certificates 38880000<38950081 and 19302956073<20000000000, giving strict inequality unless only one nonzero coefficient. Since p_m≥8/5 for m≥4, monotonic ℓ_p gives contractivity with monomial-only equality. A 3-term progression supports P=z^α+ε(z^{α+β}−z^{α−β}), with torus norm sqrt(1+4ε²) but ℓ_p>norm for small ε as p<2. No finite extrapolation.
